digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch (_cli subsystem)
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, identity, gate) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and lack reusable factory patterns
Command-level --help exhibits 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms due to inconsistent grammar definition and dispatch
Existing argparse construction imports optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor) during parser instantiation, violating lean module isolation
Parse-failure handling differs between stdlib SystemExit(2) and S2a ParseError, requiring seam reconciliation in migrated commands
Commands with custom presentations (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve byte-identical --help output while adopting factory pattern
